title: Wire AIGC governed work-order execution slice
objective: Create a dry-run work-order packet that classifies operator intent, routes internal agents, validates artifacts, and preserves human approval gates.
domain: secure software engineering and AI governance
acceptance_criteria: Every generated JSON artifact validates against a schema.
External actions remain blocked by default.
Approval requires exact visible operator review language.
No raw secret values are stored, printed, or logged.
Symbolic layers do not grant execution authority.
operator_visible_summary: Internal AIGC work-order dry run for functional wiring only.

secret_references.purpose: Reference-only placeholder for future command-center authorization; no secret value is stored.
